runtime_compatibility.reason: Game 0.5.7 rejects classic Mod API DLLs built before 0.5.6. The production DLL now uses the official frozen stable ABI and does not compile any old client/server extension vtables. The four BP layout overrides remain historical 0.5.1-derived static assets; manual 0.5.7 UI verification is required.

engine_limitations.raptor_and_krug: TFM2 has no fifth or sixth ordinary neutral actor/spawn state; these two generated packs are not claimed as independently spawning camps.
engine_limitations.elemental_dragon_state_machine: API 0.8 deterministically selects one of five base elemental dragons per match from the authoritative match seed. The final Sprite texture and objective text are rewritten in the same MatchUIRunner post-render pass from the same active selection, so the model and displayed name cannot diverge. The public API still exposes no safe per-respawn rotation, Dragon Soul, or Elder-transition hook, and a replay opened before any MatchUIRunner database handle safely retains default serpen.
engine_limitations.first_blood_announcer: The official First Blood event, container, media ID, WEM and decoded hash are audited. TFM2 exposes native sound dispatch only for 2/3/4/5 multikills, while IngameUIRunner kill logs and play_sound remain private and Mod API 0.8 has no safe global first-kill sound callback. No OS-level bypass or guessed every-kill remap is shipped.
